interface.title: Polar Pipeline (lite): File Search + Protein Figure Generator
interface.stage_of_work: Downstream of variant calling: filtering variant tables and making figures for reports
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter a VCF/TSV/CSV variant table with stacked column/operator/value criteria and download the matching rows, and draw SVG figures of protein domains and variant positions for each allele (heterozygous or homozygous), saved as named presets. The two tools are separate: figure values are typed in by hand, not taken from the filtered table.

data.note: Used the seeded input/example_variants.tsv (synthetic: #CHROM, POS, ID, REF, ALT, QUAL, DP, AF, GENE, ZYGOSITY, CONSEQUENCE, with '.'/'-' missing values). input/test.tsv was opened only to see that the filter blocks carry over. The figure-generator values (BRCA1, 1863 AA, RING 24-64, BRCT 1650-1857, C61G/C64Y, a stop at 1000) were typed by hand. Before any Generate, the Result panel already showed a figure ('test | testest', struc1-3, 500 AA) left over from an earlier session.

Blocks keep their values after going back (replayed); carrying them over to another file (screens/011.webp) and Delete Parameter (screens/012.webp) were seen once but not replayed

not_done: A numeric filter with Include N/As unchecked (QUAL >= 30 in screens/015.webp, and QUAL >= 30 AND DP >= 10 in screens/006.webp/008.webp) did nothing when Search was pressed: no preview and no message. Per the reviewer's reading of the code (app.py:142-153), the server casts missing values ('.'/'-', read as '') to int/float, the cast fails, and the search aborts silently. So the goal 'drop low-quality calls and also drop calls with missing QUAL/DP' could not be reached on this table; the subset always keeps the '.'/'-' rows.
DP and AF thresholds were not run on their own with N/As included; only QUAL >= 30 (with N/As) was confirmed to work
The column-name suggestion list did not draw in the headless browser, so column names were typed by hand
No VCF (with '##' meta lines) or CSV file was tried (only TSV files were in /input), and nothing can be uploaded through the interface: files have to be copied into the input folder
